beforeEffective.effectiveText: A cancer may respond less to a medicine from the start or after an earlier response. The cause can involve cell populations, drug exposure or several mechanisms.

Synthetic lethality means that two impairments together kill a cell even though either alone is tolerated; finding one genetic change does not establish that a particular drug will produce that interaction.
Controlled perturbations deliberately change specified factors and compare responses with suitable controls. A model response alone does not prove its mechanism or patient benefit.

A chemical probe is a compound used in the laboratory to switch one biological process off or on and ask what it does, so it is judged by how well it is characterised for that question and not by whether it could be given to a person.
A drug target is the molecule or structure a treatment acts on and its mechanism of action is how that action produces an effect, and each step from target to patient benefit needs its own evidence.

A targeted treatment acts on a specified molecule or process. Some block a cancer dependence; others use a molecule as an address for delivery or immune recruitment. The target name alone does not establish benefit or normal-tissue safety.

Cuánto fármaco se administra, con qué frecuencia y durante cuánto tiempo. Los fármacos contra el cáncer se han administrado durante mucho tiempo a la dosis más alta que el paciente puede soportar, y ahora los reguladores impulsan dosis elegidas por su beneficio y no por su tolerabilidad.
A half-life describes how long a specified drug concentration takes to fall by half under stated conditions; it does not by itself determine a treatment interval or when an effect ends.
Dose-dense scheduling shortens treatment intervals, while metronomic schedules use repeated lower doses; dose amount, timing, supportive care and outcomes must be assessed for the named regimen.

A backbone is the reference treatment in a combination comparison, an add-on is tested with it, and monotherapy uses one treatment; the comparison must establish what the combination adds in benefit and harm.
Pharmacokinetics follows a named medicine or its components through the body by measuring concentration over time, which differs from both the amount administered and the biological effect.
Therapeutic index is a ratio comparing doses that produce defined toxic and useful effects; a therapeutic window is a range, and neither is a personal guarantee of safety.
An interruption is a temporary pause, a reduction uses a lower dose, and discontinuation stops the treatment. What a change means depends on the medicine, treatment plan and reason for changing it.

A model that claims to have learned biology should, without being told, point at the known mechanism of a known drug or the known marker of a known cell type; recovering such known biology is an orthogonal check that a correlation is not an artefact.
Target engagement asks whether a drug reaches and interacts with its intended target in the tested setting. The effect on the cell and the benefit of treatment need their own measurements.
